clips.title: The story
paras: At Menethil Harbor’s bridge, Tarrel Rockweaver anxiously waits for news of his wife, Merrin. The dwarf fears for her safety after she joined an inland archaeological expedition.

Tarrel Rockweaver watches the bridge at Menethil Harbor, where trade and military shipments pass. His wife, Merrin Rockweaver, joined Prospector Whelgar’s prestigious archaeological expedition deeper in the Wetlands. Violent raptors overran the excavation site and cut off regular communication. Stranded in town, Tarrel begs travelers to scout east toward Whelgar’s Excavation Site and learn whether Merrin survived.
